scope.implementedHere: Vocabulary and verb extension of the existing Arcade; compact planning projection; responsive controls.
scope.independentlyReviewed: Profile client, three-way merge, IndexedDB store and Python API written by other agents.
scope.notClaimed: The feature author is not an independent scorer of the booster UI. Production routing and deployment are verified separately.

checked: All five game modes complete a round and produce a valid progress backup.
A wrong first answer remains unchanged after later correct practice.
Hints, typed drafts, selected settings and completed answers survive reload.
Verb difficulty separates present and past; mixed rounds contain both tenses.
Masculine and feminine essere forms, reflexive pronouns and authored participle alternatives are accepted; wrong auxiliary, person and missing accent remain incorrect.
A correct feminine answer remains visible as entered instead of being replaced by a masculine model.
Noun plural recall checks the complete article and noun; saving adds it to the personal word bank.
The six-person conjugation table and named source references are optional and fit narrow screens.
No horizontal overflow at tested widths; new primary controls have at least 44px targets.
Keyboard selection and answering work; feedback receives focus.
No browser runtime errors in the audited journeys.
Lightweight planning metadata has the same review identities as the complete catalogue without importing full teaching bodies into initial hydration.

independentProfileReview.verdict: Pass for the reviewed implementation after the request-window fixes; this is an engineering review, not a security certification or observed learner study.
securityRead: PIN hashes use a random per-profile salt, scrypt and a separate server-side HMAC pepper.
API responses and progress exports do not contain raw PINs or PIN hashes.
Session tokens are random, stored hashed server-side and placed in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure production cookie.
Writes enforce the configured origin; payload size, schema envelope, authentication attempts and active handler count are bounded.
Per-account and IP throttles persist in the database; client IP forwarding is accepted only from configured trusted proxies.
Three-way merging treats related activity records atomically, merges independent changes and exposes overlapping changes for a user decision.

findingsResolved.finding: A learner could type during the first profile PUT and have those edits replaced by the pre-request snapshot.
findingsResolved.repair: Rebase edits made while joining and leave them marked as saving until the next successful sync.

findingsResolved.finding: A learner could type while logout was pending and have that new work cleared after the response.
findingsResolved.repair: Retain local work, report the expired session and require sign-in before another upload.

regressionCases: Typing while the first join save is delayed survives locally and reaches the server on the next sync.
Typing while logout is delayed survives locally; the expired state prevents further sync requests.
Changing a synced profile immediately shows saving and remains saving while its PUT is delayed.
Typing while IndexedDB stores the merge base remains pending and reaches the server on the next sync.
Stopping during an IndexedDB write prevents the cancelled operation from republishing a profile link or a false synced state.
remainingLimits: No production reverse-proxy or TLS assertion is made by this code review.
The short PIN is protected with hashing and throttling; a short PIN is not equivalent to a high-entropy password.
Long-term usability and learning outcomes still need real learner observation.
independentProfileReview.scoreNote: This bounded engineering review does not assign a numeric product score. Separate independent learner/UI rubrics assess the requested thresholds.
